corrections.text: The article describes The New Stack's September 25, 2026 column as one whose series is presented by sponsor HPE. The page itself is tagged as a sponsored post and states 'HPE sponsored this post'. The survey and New Relic items cited from it are not about HPE, and that column is not counted as an independent source.

The article says 'InfoQ's reading connects the two' (sampling and ingest-time reduction). InfoQ says only that 'Sampling decisions now map directly to a bill'; it does not mention Atlassian or ingest-time reduction. The link between sampling and collector-side data reduction is the Herald's own comparison of sources.

The headline and summary pair OpenTelemetry's maturity with Cloudflare's per-gigabyte billing change. None of the cited sources states that one caused or influenced the other, and none compares Cloudflare's pricing with other vendors'.
